bio_am: Ծնած է Վան՝ 1873-ին։ Կամաւորական երրորդ գունդի հրամանատարը, 1921 Փետրուար 16-ին Երեւանի բանտին մէջ Չեկայի կողմէ կացինահար սպաննուեցաւ։
bio_en: Hamazasp Srvandztian was born in Van in 1873, a goldsmith by trade, and joined the ARF as a youth. During the Armenian-Tatar clashes of 1905-06 he went to the Caucasus and won fame as a band leader in Karabakh, celebrated in an ashugh song as the hero of Askeran. In 1914 he was a delegate to the ARF General Congress, and in the war he commanded the 3rd Armenian volunteer regiment. At the end of 1920 he commanded the republican troops of Nor Bayazet; arrested by the Bolsheviks, he was killed with an axe in Yerevan prison by the Cheka on 16 February 1921, on the eve of the February uprising.
